Study of electrons, protons and gamma radiation in low earth orbit.
Description

The CubeSat 3U format spacecraft for BG-Optics was created on the basis of a new platform developed by Neuro-Master (a resident of Sirius INTC). The satellite is equipped with an improved version of the DeCoR detector - DeCoR-2 (SINP MGU), which is designed to monitor charged particles in low Earth orbit.
